title: GameEngine asset manifest
description: Names every texture, animation and sound a game can ask for by name. Paths are resolved by the game's IAssetSource, which by default looks under assets/.

$schema.description: Points editors and agents at this schema.

animations.description: Animation name to the strip it plays. Frames are read left to right across a single horizontal strip.

texture.description: Name of a texture declared above.

frames.description: Number of frames in the strip.

frameDelayMs.description: Milliseconds per frame. 0 means a static image.

sounds.description: Sound name to audio file path.
